basic_info.description: Welcome to 2964 43rd Avenue, a single-family home nestled in the desirable Outer Parkside neighborhood of San Francisco. Just blocks away from the breathtaking Ocean Beach, Lake Merced Park, SF Zoo and the vibrant shops, restaurants and public transportation of Taraval St., this residence combines comfort, convenience, and style. With 1,012 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this home features two bedrooms and one bathroom, perfect for cozy, modern living. The main floor boasts an open floor plan where a beautifully updated kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area and living room, complete with ocean views looking down Wawona St. The lower level offers an attached garage, abundant storage, and additional space, ideal for a home gym or office.  The backyard is a private oasis for entertaining or relaxing, enhancing the indoor-outdoor lifestyle.  Come experience the unique blend of coastal charm and city living at 2964 43rd Avenuewhere every detail has been crafted to create a warm and inviting home.
